components.role: Largest answer-position query rotation (part of the shared L12 q_proj change with h0/h1); retargets attention to the user's-guess region ~10-11 tokens back, more strongly in B; its OV writes answer-token directions
Positional head whose attention change peaks ~11-12 tokens back (the stated guess); B attends there more and, as a copying head, copies answer tokens more
Same guess-position attention change (peak Δ≈11); copying head; stronger attention and copying in B
Large answer-position query rotation aimed at the guess/question-end region (Δ≈11-22); its OV writes answer-token directions (3-4.5x random); attends more there in B
Large query rotation; answer-writing OV (3.6x); B copies answer tokens from context more (Δz -2.2)
Answer-position switch: u256 strongly active in base and kept in B, suppressed in A, while A boosts u186; output feeds L8 u706 and L9/L10 value projections
Strongest signed change: attends more to the fixed-offset guess position in B (A less)
Large query rotation aimed ~10 tokens back (guess); writes answer-token directions; stronger in B
Strong late copying head whose copying of answer tokens into the output is stronger in B
Most structured output-side change (down_proj outlier, unit 750 writes answer tokens); decodes the copied guess into logits

evidence: Signs fixed with a GELU-gate anchor validated across all 18 layers. (1) 14 heads, sharpest L10 h0/h2/h3, change attention to a fixed token ~11 back (likely the guess); A attends less, B more, robust across variants. (2) In an output-derived answer-token subspace, OV copying is weaker in A: copy heads copy less (L15h2, L14h2, L7h0/2/3, L10h0/2) and anti-copy heads suppress more; about -2 sigma vs random subspaces, consistent in 20 of 21 constructions. (3) Strong duplicate-token heads (L3h3, L0h1) match repeated answer tokens more in B; negative net in all 15 constructions. (4) L12 h0/h1/h3 and L13h3 have the largest query rotations and write answer-token directions. (5) L7 u256/u186 switch at the answer position. Main caveat: B's verdict assumes the ~11-back token is the guess. Counter-evidence: a crude isotropic full-space OV trace favoured A, and early heads L0h2/L2h1 match more in A.
